ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels (estimated >90%) with highly localized high-intensity white pixels (estimated <10%) corresponding to scars and tip colonization.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid black pigmentation across both lobes; discrete white circular 'rosette' blobs scattered across central regions; white linear streaks in the upper-left and mid-right fluke areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with a defined vertex and an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly toward the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve terminating in sharply upturned, slightly acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 14 circular high-contrast white ring clusters (approx. 10-20 pixels in diameter) across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent 2D curved linear white disruption on the upper-left lobe; several shorter horizontal and diagonal linear marks on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-intensity white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips; circular scarring consistent with barnacle detachment; multiple unaligned linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips of the lobes feature dense, high-contrast white clusters that are visually distinct from the rest of the fluke pigmentation.
